claims.explanation: Deforolimus is a rapalog that allosterically inhibits mTORC1, and selective killing tracks with constitutive activation of the PI3K/AKT/mTOR axis. Sensitizing features include PTEN loss, PIK3CA mutation, upstream RTK mutations (EGFR, MET, KIT), and loss of negative regulators (STK11, NF1, NF2), while FBXW7/EP300 mutations and RAS pathway mutations (KRAS) are enriched in less affected lines and may confer protection. The virtual cell's top similar drugs are mTOR/PI3K inhibitors, confirming this pathway as the primary determinant.
